name: ARN Smart Image Optimizer
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart Image Optimizer is a modern WordPress image optimization plugin for converting JPG, JPEG, and PNG images to WebP or AVIF directly on your own server.

It combines automatic deferred conversion after upload, manual bulk conversion, smart on-demand generation, responsive image delivery, Media Library status controls, conversion coverage tracking, and separate WebP and AVIF quality settings in one lightweight workflow.

Unlike traditional plugins that aggressively convert every possible image variation immediately, ARN Smart Image Optimizer can prepare optimized variants after WordPress finishes saving an upload or generate the selected format only when it is needed. This reduces unnecessary processing, disk writes, unused files, and editor upload conflicts while keeping original media available as a safe fallback.

This Free WordPress.org edition works locally and does not require an ARN Smart account, license key, or external image optimization service.

🚀 Features

  • ✅ Convert JPG, JPEG, and PNG images to WebP or AVIF
  • ✅ Automatic deferred conversion after upload
  • ✅ Manual bulk conversion tools for existing Media Library images
  • ✅ Smart on-demand conversion workflow
  • ✅ Media Library conversion status indicators and actions
  • ✅ Intelligent WebP or AVIF delivery for src, srcset, and responsive image output
  • ✅ Support for common lazy-loading image attributes
  • ✅ Request-aware optimization flow
  • ✅ Conversion coverage tracking
  • ✅ Stale-variant detection after WordPress Image Editor changes
  • ✅ Lightweight and resource-aware processing
  • ✅ Local-only image conversion
  • ✅ Basic optimization statistics
  • ✅ Separate WebP and AVIF quality controls
  • ✅ Original-file fallback for unsupported environments

🛡️ Why ARN Smart Image Optimizer?

ARN Smart Image Optimizer focuses on efficient and controlled optimization instead of aggressive background processing.

The plugin is designed to:

  • ⚡ reduce unnecessary conversions
  • ⚡ avoid excessive server load
  • ⚡ limit unused generated files and disk writes
  • ⚡ keep media handling lightweight
  • ⚡ protect page and post editor upload workflows
  • ⚡ provide visibility into conversion status
  • ⚡ improve next-generation image delivery
  • ⚡ preserve original images for safe fallback behavior

It is suitable for site owners, developers, content teams, stores, blogs, and other WordPress websites that need practical WebP or AVIF optimization without depending on a remote cloud conversion service.

🧠 Smart Optimization Workflow

ARN Smart Image Optimizer uses a smart optimization workflow designed to reduce unnecessary processing and improve resource efficiency.

Instead of aggressively generating every possible optimized file immediately, the plugin can generate the selected next-generation format only when needed. This helps reduce:

  • unnecessary CPU usage
  • excessive disk writes
  • unused generated files
  • heavy background processing
  • duplicate conversion work

The system follows a lightweight request-aware optimization approach:

Detect → Check → Generate → Serve

The plugin checks whether a current optimized variant already exists before creating another file. Compatible browsers can receive the selected next-generation format while the original remains available as a fallback.

This allows WordPress sites to optimize media in a more controlled and efficient way.

📤 Safer Upload-Time Conversion

Image conversion is deferred until WordPress completes the attachment and metadata save process.

This workflow helps:

  • ✅ avoid blocking the main upload request
  • ✅ reduce conversion-related failures inside page and post editors
  • ✅ prevent metadata write conflicts
  • ✅ preserve the normal WordPress media workflow
  • ✅ keep automatic optimization available after upload

If an image is later modified with the WordPress Image Editor, stale optimized variants can be detected so outdated files are not treated as current conversions.

⚡ Force Display Engine

ARN Smart Image Optimizer includes a Force Display system designed to improve WebP and AVIF delivery consistency across WordPress output.

When optimized variants are available, the plugin can intelligently serve the selected format across supported output contexts, including:

  • image src
  • responsive srcset
  • lazy-load attributes
  • responsive image output

The goal is to improve optimized image coverage while maintaining fallback compatibility for unsupported browsers or environments.

📊 Media Library and Conversion Visibility

The Media Library integration helps administrators understand which images have optimized variants and which files still need attention.

Available workflow elements include:

  • ✅ WebP or AVIF status indicators
  • ✅ conversion actions inside the media workflow
  • ✅ optimization counts for the selected output format
  • ✅ basic converted and pending visibility
  • ✅ conversion coverage awareness

This makes image optimization easier to inspect than workflows that run silently without clear feedback.

⭐ Upgrade to ARN WebPix Pro

ARN WebPix is the professional image optimization and delivery system for production websites, large media libraries, agencies, developers, and teams that need deeper operational control.

WebPix expands the Free workflow with advanced capabilities such as:

  • ⚡ Real filesystem discovery — scans actual media files and identifies originals, generated sizes, missing files, orphaned assets, and optional external sources beyond WordPress attachment metadata.
  • ⚡ Full coverage intelligence — evaluates attachments and individual physical files as fully converted, partially converted, or not converted.
  • ⚡ Dedicated WebP and AVIF storage — keeps generated formats in predictable, separate folders for cleaner maintenance, migration, rebuilding, and CDN workflows.
  • ⚡ Advanced Force Display controls — provides wider delivery enforcement and scope control for supported output contexts.
  • ⚡ Queue-based production processing — tracks pending, processing, completed, and failed jobs while preventing duplicate work.
  • ⚡ Advanced bulk and regenerate tools — rebuilds generated formats, requeues eligible files, and supports controlled recovery workflows.
  • ⚡ Conversion Inspector and detailed statistics — exposes source counts, missing variants, coverage percentages, operation results, failures, and queue behavior.
  • ⚡ Operation logs and diagnostics — provides clearer visibility for troubleshooting large or complex media libraries.
  • ⚡ Extended media pipelines — supports PDF first-page previews with Imagick and video sidecar generation with FFmpeg when the server provides them.
  • ⚡ CDN-ready delivery architecture — uses predictable generated-file paths and extendable delivery controls.
  • ⚡ Licensed updates and priority support — connects the installation to ARN Smart for professional update delivery and assistance.

Learn more about the complete professional system:

🆓 Free vs ARN WebPix Pro

The Free edition includes essential WordPress image optimization features:

  • ✅ WebP and AVIF conversion
  • ✅ automatic deferred conversion after upload
  • ✅ manual bulk conversion
  • ✅ smart on-demand generation
  • ✅ responsive image and srcset delivery
  • ✅ Media Library integration
  • ✅ basic conversion visibility and statistics
  • ✅ separate quality controls
  • ✅ local-only processing
  • ✅ no account or license requirement

ARN WebPix Pro is designed for advanced production workflows that require:

  • ⭐ deeper filesystem and source discovery
  • ⭐ attachment-level and physical-file coverage analysis
  • ⭐ separate generated-file storage architecture
  • ⭐ advanced queue and processing control
  • ⭐ complete bulk, regenerate, maintenance, and recovery tools
  • ⭐ detailed inspection, reporting, and diagnostics
  • ⭐ wider media processing and CDN-ready delivery
  • ⭐ licensed updates and professional support

Choose ARN Smart Image Optimizer for essential local WebP and AVIF optimization. Choose ARN WebPix when the website requires production-scale processing, deeper visibility, and advanced operational control.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate ARN Smart Image Optimizer.
  3. Open Image Optimizer > Settings.
  4. Select WebP or AVIF as the output format.
  5. Configure the corresponding quality and delivery settings.
  6. Use Image Optimizer > Tools to convert existing Media Library images.

AVIF output requires AVIF encoding support in GD or ImageMagick. Available formats depend on the PHP image libraries installed by the hosting provider.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account or license key?

No. The Free edition works locally without an ARN Smart account or license key.

Does the plugin send site data to ARN Smart?

No. The Free WordPress.org build does not perform license validation, remote policy calls, or cloud image conversion.

Which formats are supported?

JPG, JPEG, and PNG images can be converted to WebP or AVIF. AVIF output requires AVIF encoding support in GD or ImageMagick on the server.

Does the plugin support automatic optimization?

Yes. Images are queued after WordPress completes the upload and metadata save process, avoiding conversion delays and failures inside the editor upload request.

Can I convert existing Media Library images?

Yes. The plugin includes manual bulk conversion tools for eligible existing images.

Does the plugin replace original images?

No. Original media files remain available and are not replaced by default.

Does the plugin work without external cloud services?

Yes. The Free edition processes images locally on the WordPress installation.

Does the plugin support responsive images and srcset delivery?

Yes. ARN Smart Image Optimizer includes intelligent WebP and AVIF delivery support for responsive image output and srcset handling.

Can the plugin generate optimized files only when needed?

Yes. The plugin includes a smart request-aware workflow designed to avoid unnecessary processing and unused generated files.

Is AVIF support included in the Free edition?

Yes. Select AVIF in Output Format. The server must provide GD imageavif() or ImageMagick AVIF encoding support.

Is the plugin compatible with shared hosting environments?

Yes. It is designed with lightweight and resource-aware workflows suitable for many standard WordPress hosting environments. Actual processing capacity depends on the server configuration and media library size.

What does ARN WebPix Pro add?

WebPix adds real filesystem discovery, detailed coverage analysis, dedicated generated-file storage, advanced queues, extended delivery controls, rebuild and recovery tools, operation logs, extended media pipelines, CDN-ready architecture, licensed updates, and priority support.

Will my original media remain available if I upgrade to WebPix?

Yes. Original WordPress media remains available. Create a current backup and follow the supplied migration instructions before changing editions or running large maintenance operations.

  • Deferred upload conversion until after WordPress finishes saving attachment metadata.
  • Fixed upload failures in post and page editor media flows.
  • Added stale-variant detection after WordPress Image Editor changes.
  • Updated statistics to follow the selected output format.
  • Corrected the installation ZIP root folder.
  • Updated the tested compatibility target to WordPress 7.1.

1.0.1

  • Updated compatibility for the current WordPress admin interface.
  • Improved optimization workflows and general stability.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Added WebP conversion, Media Library integration, bulk tools, request-aware generation, and optimized delivery.
